settings.title: Try with a clear window
settings.text: If an unopened or eligible product does not feel right within the stated return window, contact us with your order details.

settings.title: Literacy still comes first
settings.text: We would rather you understand the mechanism before you buy — and we stand behind that honesty when something is not the right fit.

settings.title: How to start a return
settings.text: Write to support with your order number, product, and a short note. We will confirm eligibility and next steps.

settings.question: Does every product qualify?
settings.answer: Eligibility follows the store return policy — typically unused or within the published window. Opened hygiene products may have limits for safety reasons.

settings.question: How long do I have?
settings.answer: Use the window shown at checkout and in your order email. If you are unsure, contact us before the window closes.

settings.question: Will I get a full refund?
settings.answer: Approved returns are refunded to the original payment method after we receive and check the item, minus any stated shipping exceptions.

settings.heading: Buy with clarity. Return with dignity.
settings.text: We want you confident in the science — and supported if a formula is not the right match. Here is how our money-back promise works in plain language.
settings.body_text: Project Skin is literacy-led. That means fewer impulse stacks and more intentional purchases. When something still misses, we handle returns carefully and respectfully.
settings.faq_text: Short answers. For order-specific cases, write to us with your details.
settings.cta_text: Our team will guide eligibility, pickup or ship-back steps, and refund timing.
